title: Tutorials for Learning VS Code in GitHub Codespaces
text: core tutorials introduce students VS Code integrated development environment. VS Code Scripts (“01-code”). Introduce students VS Code writing R code simple scripts. VS Code Quarto (“02-quarto”). Demonstrate tricks working R code using VS Code, also explain Quarto documents. Terminal (“03-terminal”). Teach command line. AI Introduction (“04-ai-1”). Meet Gemini CLI agent use create render Quarto analysis. VS Code GitHub Introduction (“05-github-1”). Explain basics Git GitHub, mostly context VS Code. VS Code GitHub Advanced (“06-github-2”). Provide practice working Git/GitHub, including details use GitHub Pages. AI Git (“07-ai-2”). Return Gemini CLI, now using run explain full Git workflow. Quarto Websites Introduction (“08-websites-1”). Demonstrate basics website construction using Quarto projects. Quarto Websites Advanced (“09-websites-2”). Practice Quarto websites, building two sites refactoring analysis code scripts save results RDS PNG files. Infrastructure (“10-infrastructure”). Tour devcontainers keep Codespaces consistent. R Data Science Analyzing US Census Data tutorials now live separate misc.tutorials package.
